description: Recent delivery attempts for one webhook (Streaming Lite tier and up), newest first — the debugging surface for 'why isn't my webhook firing'. Each row: status (pending/success/failed), HTTP response_code, attempts, delivered_at and the payload that was sent. A pending row with attempts > 0 is mid-retry-backoff; status 'failed' with response_code null means the endpoint was unreachable or timed out (8s). Page backwards through a deep queue with before_id = the smallest id on the previous page; a page shorter than limit is the last one.

before_id.description: Cursor: smallest delivery id from the previous page.

name: propline_get_webhook_deliveries
title: Get webhook deliveries
